#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail ROOT="$(pwd)" TOOLS="$ROOT/.render-tools" JDK_DIR="$TOOLS/jdk" GRADLE_DIR="$TOOLS/gradle" SDK_DIR="$TOOLS/android-sdk" PUBLIC_DIR="$ROOT/public" mkdir -p "$TOOLS" "$PUBLIC_DIR" echo "== SANCHESTV 2.6 reproducible Android build ==" rm -rf "$JDK_DIR" mkdir -p "$JDK_DIR" curl -fL --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 \ "https://corretto.aws/downloads/latest/amazon-corretto-17-x64-linux-jdk.tar.gz" \ -o "$TOOLS/jdk17.tar.gz" tar -xzf "$TOOLS/jdk17.tar.gz" -C "$JDK_DIR" --strip-components=1 export JAVA_HOME="$JDK_DIR" export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" java -version rm -rf "$GRADLE_DIR" curl -fL --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 \ "https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.9-bin.zip" \ -o "$TOOLS/gradle.zip" unzip -q "$TOOLS/gradle.zip" -d "$TOOLS" mv "$TOOLS/gradle-8.9" "$GRADLE_DIR" export PATH="$GRADLE_DIR/bin:$PATH" gradle --version rm -rf "$SDK_DIR" "$TOOLS/android-cmd" mkdir -p "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools" curl -fL --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 \ "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip" \ -o "$TOOLS/android-tools.zip" unzip -q "$TOOLS/android-tools.zip" -d "$TOOLS/android-cmd" mv "$TOOLS/android-cmd/cmdline-tools" "$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/latest" export ANDROID_HOME="$SDK_DIR" export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_DIR" export PATH="$SDK_DIR/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$SDK_DIR/platform-tools:$PATH" yes | sdkmanager --sdk_root="$SDK_DIR" --licenses >/dev/null 2>&1 || true sdkmanager --sdk_root="$SDK_DIR" \ "platforms;android-35" \ "build-tools;35.0.0" \ "platform-tools" gradle --no-daemon --stacktrace testDebugUnitTest gradle --no-daemon --stacktrace assembleDebug APK="$ROOT/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk" test -s "$APK" AAPT="$SDK_DIR/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt" "$AAPT" dump badging "$APK" | tee "$PUBLIC_DIR/apk-badging.txt" grep -q "package: name='com.mukasanches.zapptv'" "$PUBLIC_DIR/apk-badging.txt" grep -q "versionName='2.6.0'" "$PUBLIC_DIR/apk-badging.txt" cp "$APK" "$PUBLIC_DIR/SANCHESTV-2.6.0.apk" ( cd "$PUBLIC_DIR" sha256sum "SANCHESTV-2.6.0.apk" > "SANCHESTV-2.6.0.sha256" ) APK_SIZE="$(du -h "$PUBLIC_DIR/SANCHESTV-2.6.0.apk" | cut -f1)" APK_SHA="$(cut -d' ' -f1 "$PUBLIC_DIR/SANCHESTV-2.6.0.sha256")" cat > "$PUBLIC_DIR/index.html" < SANCHESTV 2.6
S▶ SANCHES TV

Baixar SANCHESTV 2.6.0 APK
